scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local center = Vector3.new(0, 100, 0)
local radius = 1300
local step = 20
local delayTime = 0.01


for x = -radius, radius, step do
    for z = -radius, radius, step do
        -- Check if (x, z) lies within the circle
        if x^2 + z^2 <= radius^2 then
            local targetPos = Vector3.new(center.X + x, center.Y, center.Z + z)
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos)
            task.wait(delayTime)
        end
    end
end

hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)

        v.VehicleSeat:SetAttribute("Disabled", false)

end

task.wait(0.2)
for _, v in pairs(workspace.RuntimeItems:GetChildren()) do
    if v.Name == "MaximGun" and v:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat") and (hrp.Position - v.VehicleSeat.Position).Magnitude < 400 then
        hrp.CFrame = v.VehicleSeat.CFrame
    end
end

task.wait(0.5)
hrp.Anchored = false
repeat task.wait(0.1) until hum.Sit
task.wait(0.3)
hum.Sit = false
task.wait(0.2)

repeat
    for _, v in pairs(workspace.RuntimeItems:GetChildren()) do
        if v.Name == "MaximGun" and v:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat") and (hrp.Position - v.VehicleSeat.Position).Magnitude < 400 then
            hrp.CFrame = v.VehicleSeat.CFrame
        end
    end
    task.wait(0.2)
until hum.Sit

task.wait(0.4)
